items.raw_excerpt: OpenAI 首席执行官山姆・奥特曼在一篇博客文章中表示：“用户生成的视频内容数量远超我们预期，而且许多视频的受众规模非常小。”“我们必须通过某种方式让视频生成业务实现盈利。”奥特曼称，公司计划与希望用户生成其角色的版权方分享部分收入。具体的盈利模式还需经过反复尝试（才能确定），相关计划将很快启动。

title_i18n.zh: 奥特曼拟通过 Sora 实现 AI 视频生成商业化
title_i18n.en: OpenAI plans to commercialize AI video generation through Sora.
title_i18n.es: OpenAI planea comercializar la generación de vídeos con IA mediante Sora.

excerpt_i18n.zh: OpenAI 首席执行官山姆・奥特曼在一篇博客文章中表示：“用户生成的视频内容数量远超我们预期，而且许多视频的受众规模非常小。”“我们必须通过某种方式让视频生成业务实现盈利。”奥特曼称，公司计划与希望用户生成其角色的版权方分享部分收入。具体的盈利模式还需经过反复尝试（才能确定），相关计划将很快启动。
excerpt_i18n.en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman stated in a blog post that the volume of user-generated video content has far exceeded their expectations, with many videos reaching very small audiences. He emphasized the necessity for the video generation business to become profitable and announced plans to share a portion of revenue with copyright holders who wish to have users generate their characters. The specific profit model will require iterative testing to finalize, and the initiative is set to launch soon.
excerpt_i18n.es: El director ejecutivo de OpenAI, Sam Altman, declaró en una entrada de blog que la cantidad de contenido de video generado por usuarios supera con creces sus expectativas y que muchas de estas producciones tienen audiencias muy reducidas. Afirmó que es necesario encontrar una forma de hacer rentable el negocio de generación de videos. La empresa planea compartir parte de los ingresos con los titulares de derechos que deseen que los usuarios creen sus personajes. El modelo específico de monetización aún requiere pruebas iterativas para determinarse, y los planes relacionados se pondrán en marcha próximamente.

items.title: Show HN: Got sick and tired of AI in search engines, so I made my own
items.raw_excerpt:
I got sick and tired of how much AI was being pushed at me from nearly every search engine. So I built my own, Project Glass. It is built on a few core beliefs: Transparency and Privacy is paramount. AI isn't required. Real user engagement is the best signal. It has a clear transparent (puns intended) algorithm, that you can view on the home page, it takes the following things into account for the ranking:
1. Title
2. Snippet
3. Number of clicks/Click Rate
4. Recency (with a slow decay) It uses 0 front end Javascript, and no AI in any part of the creation or use of this. I have been working on this for a while, and this has been my daily use search engine for a few weeks now, if you can please try it out, let me know what you think, and please be kind! Ill be around all day to answer quest

title_i18n.es: Mostré en HN: Me harté de la inteligencia artificial en los motores de búsqueda, así que creé el mío propio.

excerpt_i18n.en:
I got sick and tired of how much AI was being pushed at me from nearly every search engine. So I built my own, Project Glass. It is built on a few core beliefs: Transparency and Privacy is paramount. AI isn't required. Real user engagement is the best signal. It has a clear transparent (puns intended) algorithm, that you can view on the home page, it takes the following things into account for the ranking:
1. Title
2. Snippet
3. Number of clicks/Click Rate
4. Recency (with a slow decay) It uses 0 front end Javascript, and no AI in any part of the creation or use of this. I have been working on this for a while, and this has been my daily use search engine for a few weeks now, if you can please try it out, let me know what you think, and please be kind! Ill be around all day to answer quest
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我对几乎每个搜索引擎都在大力推广AI感到厌烦至极，于是自己创建了一个名为“玻璃计划”的搜索引擎。它基于几个核心理念：透明与隐私至上，无需依赖人工智能。
excerpt_i18n.es: Me harté de lo mucho que me empujaban la inteligencia artificial desde casi todos los motores de búsqueda. Así que construí el mío, Proyecto Glass. Se basa en algunas creencias fundamentales: la transparencia y la privacidad son primordiales. La inteligencia artificial no es necesaria.

excerpt_i18n.zh: GenBI作为AI领域的新兴技术，旨在通过智能分析提升决策效率，避免数据在仪表板中闲置。它结合了生成式AI与商业智能，帮助企业从数据中获取更深入的洞察。
